# `Q-3-21` — Caption Block Not Supported

> Standalone caption blocks cannot be rendered in this output
> format. Captions should be attached to figures or tables.

## What this means

A caption is a piece of text bound to the thing it describes — a
figure, a table, a code block. The Quarto AST has a `Caption`
node type, but every well-formed render attaches that caption to
its parent before the writer runs. A *standalone* caption is one
that lost (or never had) its parent, and the writer has no
target to associate it with.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A Lua filter dropped the parent.** The filter removed a
  figure or table but left its caption behind in the document.
- **A filter generated an orphan caption.** The filter produced
  a `CaptionBlock` node directly, without attaching it to a
  block.

The default Quarto pipeline does not produce orphan captions.

## How to fix

If a custom filter is in use, audit it for block-removal logic
that does not also drop the caption, or for caption-emitting
logic that forgets to attach to a parent.

If no custom filter is in use, report the document at the Quarto
issue tracker — postprocessing should have associated the
caption with its block.
